descriptions.arrowpoint-cattle-company: All natural grass-fed highland beef. Holistically raised from start to finish at 8,000 ft. in Colorado. Established in 1959.
descriptions.badger-creek-ranch: Land health is at the core of the mission at Badger Creek Ranch. The family owned and operated working ranch is managed mindfully with respect and love for the relationship between people, land, animals and the ancestors of the land they steward. The offerings are grass fed and finished beef and lamb, pork, chicken and eggs. The hogs, chickens and turkeys are fed certified organic, non-soy feed and they enjoy living outside on the land. On-line ordering can be found on the website. Produce can be picked up at the farm store in Coaldale, or at the Salida, Buena Vista and Cañon City farmer’s markets.
descriptions.colorado-farm-to-table: Get involved in growing produce, relationships, and community! At Salida’s not-for-profit Colorado Farm to Table (CFTT) we grow approximately 10 acres of fresh produce for distribution to Coloradans in need. Starting in 2022, we are going to have a separate 1 acre plot of fresh vegetables to sell at the farmers market with all proceeds going back to our donation farm. The summer of 2022 will be our 26th season, CFTT has been welcoming people of all backgrounds in volunteer farming experiences to grow top-quality, nutritious produce for hungry families. Volunteer farm hands work with the farmer in 3-hour shifts. No experience is necessary – instruction and tools are provided. Join us! It’s a lot of fun and a great opportunity to meet and network with some awesome people. CFTT’s sustainably grown produce is distributed via partner nonprofit food pantries, soup kitchens, low-income housing, and feeding programs that redistribute the freshly harvested produce onto the plates of those most in need of nutrition relief. We encourage and welcome new volunteers, distribution partners, and innovative collaborative partnerships. Contact info@coloradofarmtotable.org for more information!
descriptions.colorado-mountain-lavender: A family farm and the first commercial lavender farm in South Central Colorado, discover quality lavender skin, bath, and culinary products made at the farm. Grown naturally at 7000 feet elevation, our lavender makes excellent essential oil that is incorporated into our products. You can trust the source and visit the farm in the summer to see our lavender fields up close. With over 13 different lavender cultivars at the farm and offering plant starts in early summer, learn about lavender and its wonderful benefits. Our shop features all of our products and delicious lavender blackberry ice cream. We offer most of our products year-round on our website too. We are dog-friendly (leash please). The serenity and peace of the farm, with a mix of lavender and fresh mountain air, keep visitors coming back year after year.
descriptions.copper-kettle-apothecary:
Copper Kettle Apothecary is a true herbal apothecary with a selection of over 400 medicinal herbs, teas and cooking spices sold in bulk. Feel free to bring a jar to be filled or we can use a paper bag supplied in store.
Also available are prepacked herbal supplements, botanical body care products and naturalistic themed gifts and homewares, books, candles, and sometimes houseplants.
We are fully prepared to serve every one interested in traditional remedies from the person having their first cup of herbal tea to the sixty year herbal practitioner. Consultations are available for anyone needing more guidance.
descriptions.everett-ranch-beef: Family owned and operated fifth generation historic cattle ranch producing 100% grassfed beef. No hormones or antibiotics. Find us on Facebook @everettranchbeef.
descriptions.headwater-farms: We are a farm located in the Rocky Mountains of Colorado, growing fresh produce, flower fields and a pumpkin patch. We aim to interconnect nature and humanity through agriculture.
descriptions.hutchinson-ranch:
Looking for local beef! We are as local as it gets! Our Family has been raising quality grass fed beef in Chaffee County for 7 generations! You can see our beautiful herd of Red Angus cross cattle right along hwy 50 between Salida and Poncha Springs, we are the only green pastures left in this corridor of development. We handle each animal humanly from birth to butcher we are the single owner of the animal. All beef is 100% grass fed and all natural.
We pride ourselves on providing an outstanding product so you know where your meat comes from. We love our cows, you will love our beef. Please call if you'd like a tour to come visit the ranch and learn more about our operation.
descriptions.lewis-lazy-l-ranch:
Lewis Ranch cows have been raised in the Arkansas Valley for 30 years. Our cows graze on public and private land between Poncha Springs and Leadville year round. We offer grass fat beef by the half in the fall and grass fed burger year round. All our beef is processed locally and USDA inspected. Contact Kate or Brice by phone, email, or Facebook at Lewis Lazy L Ranch.
We are also happy to provide beef delivery on larger orders and ranch tours by appointment!
descriptions.mushroom-love-co: Mushroom Love Co is a gourmet mushroom farm located right here in the high rockies! We provide oyster and lions mane mushrooms for restaurants, markets and individuals. We also have mushroom growing supplies and classes available.
descriptions.phytology-flowers-farm: We are a sustainable flower farmer and wedding and event florist in Salida. We offer summer flower subscriptions, wedding and event services, holiday arrangements, and some herbal products. We hope to offer classes and workshops in the future. We are a family farm and open by appointment.
descriptions.rocky-mountain-garlic:
Growing gourmet garlic in Salida, Rocky Mountain Garlic specializes in hard neck Garlic as well as Shallots and Onions. Last season, we experimented with many different root crops and are expanding into other hardy vegetables. We are offering “shares” for purchase! Please contact us for more information and to sign up.
We — Mike and Tiffany Collette — grow following organic and biodynamic processes, using an earth-friendly mentality. Our garlic is tended by hand, one clove at a time, on land that is free of chemicals. We place much importance on minimal tillage using mulches, manures, and cover crops in order to hold nutrients and rejuvenate the soil. We use drip irrigation to conserve water and bring to market a unique crop of high desert garlic. From seed to harvest to storage, our garlic is grown for you and good for you. Our mission is to provide fresh and local food, grown by people you can meet face-to-face. It is the heritage of our country and we are proud to continue the tradition!
descriptions.scanga-meat-company:
We are a small, family-run meat market, open since 1952. It is a USDA-inspected wholesale and retail meat market with beef, pork, lamb, buffalo, poultry, sausage, deli meats & cheeses, seafood, fish,
smoked & cured items, and lots more! Many Italian products are available as well. We pride ourselves on a small business atmosphere that is very clean with great competitive pricing. We also offer slaughter and processing services for beef, pork, lamb, and buffalo! Find us on Facebook at @SCANGAMEATCO
descriptions.sweet-pea-farms-wildflower-honey: Purveyors of the finest Colorado High Altitude Wildflower Honey. Raising Happy Hens for Eggs and Meat. Offering Organic Layer Feeds at the farm. Coming next fall, Grass fed beef on regerative pastures. Call or Email. Or find us at Salida Farmer's Market.
descriptions.valley-roots-food-hub: Valley Roots Food Hub is a local food aggregator and distributor based in Mosca, CO, and serving much of our great state of Colorado including Chaffee County! We serve individual customers at home looking for grocery shopping needs, as well as grocers, restaurants, caterers, buying clubs, schools, food banks, & more! Customers can enjoy up to 100+ producers from our network all on one invoice. We are open year-round with a Monday 4 PM order deadline & Thursday delivery. We also have convenient pick-up locations available. Individuals at home can participate by shopping with us each week, picking and choosing what they'd like in each order. We also have our multi-farm CSA Fresh Box program where customers pay for their share upfront and for 13 weeks in the summer, our team curates what goes in each box.
